counterfactual_missing_items: fever and lymphadenopathy suggesting systemic infection or malignancy
peri- and pararenal soft-tissue infiltration not typical of ADEM
decisive_items: multiple bilateral, symmetrical T2/FLAIR hyperintense lesions in the periventricular and periaqueductal regions
diffusion restriction and low ADC values
response.rationale: R4 (ADEM) has the most specific raw support spans directly quoting the brain MRI findings of bilateral symmetrical T2/FLAIR hyperintensities with diffusion restriction and low ADC, which are classic for ADEM. R3 (NMOSD) is the runner-up as it captures the spinal cord and periaqueductal involvement but lacks the diffusion restriction finding. Other candidates either have non-specific spans (R1) or are less consistent with the acute presentation (R5).

rejected.why: Redundant composite of R4 with identical raw support spans; correlated restatement.
Only captures spinal cord involvement; misses the characteristic brain MRI findings.
MS is less likely given the acute onset and systemic features; raw spans do not include diffusion restriction.
Toxic encephalopathy does not explain the MRI findings or acute neurological deterioration.
